# PlayCounter

> Free automatic playtime tracking for Windows, across launchers and standalone games. Import available Steam and Xbox hours and track supported emulated games.

- Public Windows release: 1.1.16, published 2026-09-08.
- Free desktop app; no PlayCounter account required. Desktop source is MIT-licensed. The current production API is private.
- Automatic tracking follows recognized running games, regardless of launcher. Unknown or ambiguous games can be reviewed locally.
- Historical importers: Steam (local account files) and Xbox (optional Microsoft sign-in; playtime availability varies by game).
- Imported totals do not recreate sessions. For a matched game, the displayed total is the higher local total or largest imported provider total, not their sum.
- Dedicated per-game emulator detection: DOSBox and Dolphin. Recognition depends on exposed game identifiers or titles.
- Recorded sessions and history stay on the PC. Matching, metadata, updates and pseudonymous installation presence use online services; optional imports have additional data flows.
